author: Muse (port)
Cryptid team (original mod)
description: 167 Jokers and 27 consumables ported from Cryptid by the Cryptid team (SpectralPack), including the Epic, Exotic, Candy and Cursed rarities, the Bulwark and UltPair poker hands, the Code and Unique consumable types, and registered Green/Azure seals, Astral/Mosaic/M editions and Cat/Double M/Rework tags. Requires the Balatro3DS fork's Tier 1 + Tier 2 + Tier 3 mod APIs (create/destroy cards, retrigger returns, SMODS.Rarity, SMODS.PokerHand, SMODS.ConsumableType, SMODS.Seal/Edition/Tag, Joker-targeting consumables, e_mult/e_chips/x_chips/balance returns). 107 Cryptid items stay blocked; see README.txt.
